QUOTE: "**Deny** entries are checked in `ServerManager::execute`, after approval has already passed." and "`ServerManager::execute` does a final deny check before routing"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer places the deny check in ServerManager::execute but claims many other gates (hooks, schema, MCP authorization, tier allowlist, approval) also precede execution, and never concludes that the deny list is the only list that blocks execution.
